verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Second IF secondary low to volume control top
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: secondary lower terminal descends to #16 track upper lug and #15 250 pF upper side.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Volume-control wiper to coupling capacitor
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: wiper arrow terminates at left side of #18 0.01 µF; crossing vertical lines do not have junction dots.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: 7C6 triode grid and grid leak
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: right side of #18 and upper end #19 connect to 7C6 triode grid lead.

verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: the bottom ends of #15, #16, and #19 share the same horizontal return line. This does not establish chassis bond.
